name.ja: ＭＧ 1/100 MS-06R-2 ロバート・ギリアム専用ザクＩＩ
name.en: MG 1/100 MS-06R-2 Robert Gilliam's Zaku II

description.ja: ＭＳＶシリーズの機体、ＭＧで続々キット化！
description.en: MSV series aircraft, MG kits are being made one after another!

description.ja: ジオン公国軍 銘機ＭＳ－０６Ｒ－２、ロバート・ギリアム大佐操る高機動型ザク！
description.en: Principality of Zeon's famous MS-06R-2, high-mobility Zaku operated by Colonel Robert Gilliam!

description.ja: 月　影　に　現　る　！　ロ　バ　ー　ト　・　ギ　リ　ア　ム　大　佐　機 　-------------------
description.en: Appearing in the shadows! Colonel Robert Gilliam -------------------

description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム ＭＳＶ』より、カラーリングとマーキングが特徴的な MS-06R-2 ロバート・ギリアム専用ザクIIを
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam MSV", MS-06R-2 Robert Gilliam's Zaku II with distinctive coloring and markings.

description.ja: 1/100スケールＭＧシリーズで商品化。
description.en: Commercialized in the 1/100 Scale MG series.

description.ja: ＭＳＶ機体独特なカラーとマーキングを、成形色と水転写デカールで再現！
description.en: The unique colors and markings of the MSV aircraft are reproduced with molded colors and water transfer decals!

description.ja: ● パーソナルカラーでカラーリングされた機体を成形色で徹底再現！
description.en: ● Thoroughly reproduce the aircraft colored in your personal color with molded colors!

description.ja: 青と黄色が基調とされるパーソナルカラーをイメージしてカラーリングされた機体を、成形色の色分けで再現。
description.en: The aircraft is colored based on the personal colors of blue and yellow, and is reproduced by color-coding the molding colors.

description.ja: ● ＭＳＶ特有のマーキング類を水転写デカールで再現！
description.en: ● Reproduce MSV-specific markings with water transfer decals!

description.ja: ＭＳＶ機体独特なラインなどのマークを含んだマーキングが、位置合わせがしやすい水転写デカールで付属。
description.en: Markings that include marks such as lines unique to the MSV aircraft are included as water transfer decals that are easy to align.

description.ja: ● ザクＩＩ本体は、広範囲な可動域をもつＶｅｒ.２.０
description.en: ● Zaku II main body is Ver.2.0 with a wide range of motion.

description.ja: ● ポージングの幅が広がる豊富な武器付属！
description.en: ● Comes with a variety of weapons that expand the range of poses!

description.ja: 付属武装 ： ジャイアント・バズーカ ／ ザク・バズーカ ／ ザク・マシンガン ／ ヒート・ホーク
description.en: Attached weapons: Giant Bazooka / Zaku Bazooka / Zaku Machine Gun / Heat Hawk
